import java.util.Scanner;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    private static final BigInteger MOD = BigInteger.valueOf(998244353);
    private static final BigInteger INV2 = BigInteger.valueOf(499122177);

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        long k = R - L + 1;
        long product = n * m;
        System.out.println(solve(k, L, R, product));

    private static BigInteger solve(long k, long L, long R, long product) {
        BigInteger exp = BigInteger.valueOf(product);
        if (product % 2 == 1) {
            return BigInteger.valueOf(k).modPow(exp, MOD);
        }
        long e = R / 2 - (L - 1) / 2;
        long o = k - e;
        BigInteger E = BigInteger.valueOf(e);
        BigInteger O = BigInteger.valueOf(o);
        BigInteger a = E.add(O).modPow(exp, MOD);
        BigInteger b = E.subtract(O).modPow(exp, MOD);
        return a.add(b).multiply(INV2).mod(MOD);
    }
}
